$comment: Høst: operators in Lua. The grammar gives every operator one scope, keyword.operator.lua, = included, so the theme could not tell + from = and all of them kept the text colour. The operators that compute get their own scopes here and so the structure colour, while = keeps the text colour. The varargs ... are a name, not a value, and keep the text colour too; the grammar calls them a constant. An injection matches before the grammar at the same position, so <const> and <close> are matched here with the grammar's own scope, or < would be taken for a comparison; - and # leave comments and the shebang line alone. Applies outside strings and comments.
